articles.summary: The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC), the world’s leading ice cream business, today shared an update on its technology roadmap as it prepares for the planned sunset of key Transitional Services Agreements (TSAs) with Unilever by the end of 2027.The roadmap is focused on putting in place practical, ready-for-the-future digital foundations acros...
